title: Bug: pause watchdog punching in test_watchdog.py for Nexthop devices
author: domingo-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

The [pytest fixture](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/005e4c81cfc8bed6e8c3a6d195569a53300e194b/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L47) requires the watchdog to be disarmed at the beginning
of each test case. Nexthop devices have watchdog enabled by default and armed by a puncher periodically. 

Therefore, the watchdog puncher should be paused and the watchdog disarmed during each test case. The watchdog puncher should be paused to also avoid race conditions in test cases that asserts conditions based on `arm` and `disarm` calls.

### Steps to Reproduce

- Run test_watchdog.py on a Nexthop device
- `watchdog_not_running` fixture fails due to watchdog being armed
- Even if disarmed, observe race conditions due to watchdog punching arming the watchdog and `disarm` call ([example](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/005e4c81cfc8bed6e8c3a6d195569a53300e194b/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L132-L136))

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

- Run test_watchdog.py on a Nexthop device
- All test cases pass with no random race conditions

### Relevant log output

```shell
E           Failed: Failed to arm the watchdog, Watchdog remaining_time 9 seconds appears wrong compared to watchdog timeout -1 seocnds, Failed to disarm the watchdog, Watchdog is not disarmed, Watchdog remaining_time 9 seconds is wrong for disarmed state, unexpected disconnection from dut
```

```shell

```

### Description of PR
Summary:

Temporarily pause watchdog punching during test case for Nexthop devices

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/21886

### Type of change

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

To satisfy the pytest fixture [condition](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/005e4c81cfc8bed6e8c3a6d195569a53300e194b/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L47C9-L47C29) and avoid race conditions due to watchdog puncher.

#### How did you do it?

In the pytest fixture (that runs setup and for each test case), disable watchdog punching and then disarm watchdog for Nexthop devices. 

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run the test cases in `test_watchdog.py` on Nexthop and non-Nexthop devices.

#### Any platform specific information?

This PR makes the `test_watchdog.py` compatible with Nexthop devices that have watchdog enabled all the time.
